# Cliptics

> Cliptics is a free, no-signup AI-powered platform offering unlimited text-to-speech conversion, professional photo editing, and image transformation tools.

Cliptics provides a comprehensive suite of AI-powered creative tools designed for content creators, marketers, and professionals. All tools are free to use without registration, supporting multiple file formats (PNG, JPG, JPEG, WebP, AVIF, MP3, WAV, OGG) and multilingual functionality for global accessibility.

## Key Topics

- AI-powered tools
- Text-to-speech (TTS)
- Photo editing
- Background removal
- Image transformation
- No signup required
- Free online tools
- Multi-voice dialogue
- Object removal
- Image compression
- Batch processing
- PNG/JPG/WebP support
- Portrait enhancement
- Green screen removal
- Sketch-to-image

## Text-to-Speech & Audio

- [Text to Speech Online Free Unlimited](https://cliptics.com/text-to-speech-online-free-unlimited): Free unlimited text-to-speech converter with 75K characters, multilingual support, no signup required.
- [Text to Speech MP3 Free](https://cliptics.com/text-to-speech): Free text-to-speech MP3 generator with multiple voices, languages, unlimited daily conversions.
- [Multi Speaker Text to Speech](https://cliptics.com/multi-speaker-text-to-speech): Create professional dialogues with 50 AI voices, 75K characters for audiobooks and podcasts.
- [Multi Voice Text to Speech](https://cliptics.com/ai-multi-voice-text-to-speech-free): Create natural conversations with multi-voice text-to-speech, dialogue generator, no signup.

## Photo Editing & Enhancement

- [AI Photo Editor with Smart Generative Fill](https://cliptics.com/ai-image-editor): Professional AI photo editor with generative fill, image transformation, and style transfer capabilities.
- [AI Portrait Enhancer](https://cliptics.com/free-ai-portrait-enhancer-photo-editor): Free AI portrait enhancer automatically enhances faces with one-click, 10 daily free edits.
- [AI Photo Filter & Effects](https://cliptics.com/ai-photo-filter): Free AI photo filter tool with anime, art styles, and creative effects, no signup required.
- [AI Sketch to Image](https://cliptics.com/ai-sketch-to-image): Transform sketches to realistic photos using AI with color prompts, free sketch-to-image generator.

## Background & Object Management

- [Remove Background](https://cliptics.com/remove-background): Free AI background remover instantly removes photo backgrounds, perfect for transparent PNGs.
- [Remove Object from Photo](https://cliptics.com/object-remover): Free AI object remover erases unwanted objects from photos instantly, no signup or watermarks.
- [Green Screen Remover](https://cliptics.com/free-green-screen-remover-tool): Free AI green screen remover for studio backgrounds, 10 daily edits, chroma key technology.
- [Blur Background](https://cliptics.com/blur-background): Free AI background blur tool for portraits, 10 daily edits, multiple format downloads.
- [Make Photo Transparent](https://cliptics.com/free-transparent-image-maker-online): Create transparent backgrounds instantly with AI, 10 daily free edits for product photos.

## Image Conversion & Formatting

- [Landscape to Portrait Image Converter](https://cliptics.com/landscape-to-portrait): Convert landscape to portrait images with AI for social media optimization, free tool.
- [Portrait to Landscape Image Converter](https://cliptics.com/portrait-to-landscape): Convert portrait to landscape images with AI for web banners and social media thumbnails.
- [Selective Color Photo Editor](https://cliptics.com/black-white-background): Create selective color effects keeping subject colorful while converting surroundings to grayscale.
- [White Background Photo Editor](https://cliptics.com/add-white-background-to-photo): Add white backgrounds to photos instantly with AI, 10 free daily edits, no signup.

## Image Optimization & Utilities

- [Image Compression](https://cliptics.com/compress-images): Free image compression and optimization tool supporting JPEG, PNG, WebP, AVIF formats.
- [Free Color Tools](https://cliptics.com/color-tools): Professional color tools including picker, gradient generator, palette creator for designers.

## Optional Developer Tools
